attributes: Identical twins; Inherited traits (eye color, nose shape, earlobe attachment) vs Acquired traits (language, skills); Polio is caused by a VIRUS (NOT INHERITED)

Gregor Johann Mendel: Born in AUSTRIA in 1822; monk who performed experiments on 28,000 PEA PLANTS over 7 years; discovered traits come in pairs (smooth/rough, yellow/green seeds) with no intermediate blends

historical_figures_and_travelers.name: Gregor Johann Mendel
historical_figures_and_travelers.key_contributions: Discovered laws of genetic inheritance with 28,000 pea plants

scientific_experiments_and_processes.name: Pea Hybridization
scientific_experiments_and_processes.procedure: Crossing smooth and rough seeded Pisum sativum

visual_assets_and_diagram_cues: Gregor Mendel portrait, pea seed inheritance grid
